metadata.description: A pure aggregation node. This component has no subpath entry points and no post-build step, so once the nested `npx nx run demo-components:build-base` shell-out became a dependsOn edge there was no command left to run -- hence `nx:noop` (a bare dependsOn with no executor is invalid; createTask throws). `outputs` is empty because build-base is the sole writer of dist/components/demo-components; declaring the directory here too would make a second task own it.

`^build`, not the empty list this used to carry. The empty list cancelled the `^build` the `@nx/angular:package` targetDefault supplies, which was safe only while this target was reachable solely through the `build` wrapper (which carried its own `^build`). Now that `build` is a plain aggregation edge, the dependency edge has to live here. `^build` and not `^build-base`: @dereekb/* imports are remapped to the dist DIRECTORY, so TypeScript reads that directory's package.json `exports`, and the dependency's own `build` (finalize-esm-exports) is what finalizes them.
